_readme: Default config for the /harness delegation skill. Copy to ~/.claude/harness.json
(or run `/harness on`, which creates it). Every field is optional — missing keys
fall back to these shipped defaults. Delete the _readme and _comments keys freely.
The harness is fully silent until this file exists AND enabled is true
(tallyWhenDisabled being the one exception — shadow measurement only).

_comments.enabled: the toggle; /harness on|off flips only this
_comments.askThresholdTokens: a BURST estimate above this turns the dispatch into a permission prompt. Deliberately high: it should fire on a fleet, not a single worker
_comments.dailyAdvisoryTokens: crossing this adds one advisory line to the injected context. It never asks
_comments.burstWindowSeconds: dispatches from the same session inside this window are costed together as one burst
_comments.reuseWindowMinutes: how long a finished worker stays listed as a reuse candidate
_comments.baseBootTokens: the unmeasurable part of every worker's boot: system prompt + tool schemas
_comments.bytesPerToken: crude bytes-to-tokens ratio; tune toward 3.4 for code-dense repos
_comments.defaultEstimates: per-worker output estimates used until the tally has enough of your own data
_comments.learnFromTally: replace defaults with your own medians once minSamplesToLearn known-token rows exist
_comments.expensiveModels: your top tier — routed to for judgment-heavy work, costed as expensive
_comments.tallyWhenDisabled: shadow mode: keep measuring dispatches while the harness is off, so /harness status has a baseline to compare against
